subject: general
question: The species which invade barren areas are called _______ species.
solution:
The correct answer is __**original inventor**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The** species that invade barren areas are called pioneer /original species. **
 
• They are the **first organisms **to colonize a disturbed or newly created environment.
 
• **Pioneer species** are hardy and adaptable organisms that can tolerate harsh conditions.
